theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.refl | red_K.refl | red_S.refl | par.refl =>
    exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩
  case red_I.red_I | red_K.red_K | red_S.red_S =>
    exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    cases I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    first
    | exact ⟨_, by assumption, .red_I _⟩
    | exact ⟨_, .red_I _, by assumption⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption)
    first
    | exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K _ _⟩
    | exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, hx⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption)
    first
    | refine ⟨_, .par (.par hx ?_) (.par hy ?_), .red_S ..⟩ <;> assumption
    | refine ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx ?_) (.par hy ?_)⟩ <;> assumption
  case par.par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
